name: cfg-adapters-unmigrated
about: 通用平台渠道 enabled 但不给凭据时的启动行为，每个渠道单独起一次（adapters/channel/loadEnabledChannels.ts:8-120 与各渠道 start()）。基线的 package.json 不依赖 grammy / discord.js / @slack/bolt / matrix-bot-sdk / dingtalk-stream / imapflow / nodemailer，这些渠道永远只打一行「not installed」并照常启动；mattermost / signal / whatsapp / homeassistant 只打缺凭据一行并照常启动。全程不联网。Rust 照基线做（channel/unavailable.rs）；配齐凭据、基线会真的去连的配置见 cfg-adapters-connecting-local。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
